mutations.name: every publish approves, not only a success
mutations.find: if (success) await approve(port, target, check, kept, result);
mutations.replace: await approve(port, target, check, kept, result);
kills: syncApproval a FIX_FIRST at the head Shepherd approved dismisses that approval, so no Shepherd approval is left standing

mutations.name: approvals at other heads only are dismissed, so the approved head keeps its own
kills: syncApproval a FIX_FIRST at the head Shepherd approved dismisses that approval, so no Shepherd approval is left standing

mutations.name: a success with no App configured records nothing
mutations.find: if (!client) return success ? { reviewError: NO_APP } : undefined;
kills: syncApproval with no App configured a success records the missing App instead of approving

mutations.name: a replay posts again instead of reusing its approval
kills: syncApproval a replay after a crash finds its approval at the head and posts no second one

mutations.name: a refused dismissal stops the rest and fails the step
mutations.find: result.reviewError ??= failed(`dismissing review ${review.id} failed`, target, check, error);
kills: syncApproval a dismissal GitHub refuses is recorded by status, and the other stale approvals are still dismissed
